1.plants_csv_values_checked: name and parent_company of all 244 plants (488 values)
1.method: token screen of every stated name/parent_company row against a fresh fetch of its cited page (visible text; browser re-render for flagged rows; OSHA rows against data/osha_2025.csv by record ID), then a phrase test for company names and legal suffixes; parentheticals and descriptors read by hand. Abbreviations of words on the page (Inc./Incorporated, Mfg./Manufacturing, Corp./Corporation, Co./Company, L L C/LLC) and plurals accepted. Street tags in names accepted when the plant's own address row carries the street. Owner labels dropped from names where only the parent row carries them (DC-sweep precedent).
1.not_fixed_unreachable: stated name/parent rows citing EPA FRS (frs-public.epa.gov timed out all day) whose value matches its quote were left as they are and not re-verified: Cozad, Smithco, Craftsmen x2, J.Q. Tex, Cronkhite x2, Shadow, Bloomer x2, Barrett x2, Hart, Merhow, SMC, Premier, Corn Pro, U-Dump, Cottrell, Pratt, JOST Grand Haven, Lippert Goshen/Middlebury parent, Trinity x2 parent, Wabash South, Bobcat Statesville, XL Specialized, Fairchild. FRS rows whose value added labels were re-cited to ECHO facility reports (echodata.epa.gov dfr_rest_services) instead.

2.method: every stated welder_postings row in the vertical screened for several named requisitions; candidates read; single-page rows naming several requisitions split one row per requisition (own URL, quote, 'listed <date>' where the page gives it); list-page rows kept as one row and re-quoted so every named role is on the quote; site-tie calls moved out of stated rows into inferred rows.

3.rows_checked: 152 plants whose welder_postings say none/unknown/not read (plus the 8 profiled ones first)
3.boards_reread: about 75 careers pages and boards rendered in a browser, embedded boards found by vendor host in the raw source and read through their JSON (ADP WFN x9 clients, Wabash ADP CX, Paycom x8, UKG Pro x3, UKG Ready x4, Oracle, Paycor, Paylocity, HireClick x2, Workday blocked 429)

4.note: only Goshen and Middlebury (now profiled) cite careers.lippert.com for these fields; the two tier rows quoted a company sentence absent from their job pages and were re-cited to sibling Plant 19/28 postings that carry it. found_by rows quote the job JSON embedded in the page (FOUND); relationship rows were fixed in round 1.
